name: DPV light ball mount holder
description: 3D-printed ball mount holder for attaching a dive light arm to a DPV using a tank strap.
body: I designed this to fit the Blacktip, but it works on every DPV,  The TPU part provides friction and prevents sliding during install.  I use a tank strap and its very solid.  Ive tested the print in ABS and PET-G, both hold up well in salt water.  Here is the link to the ball mounts I used, https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BXWWRRJ9?ref_=ppx_hzsearch_conn_dt_b_fed_asin_title_4

name: Genesis DPV stand
description: My 3D-printed Genesis DPV stand with curved cradles, a spacer insert, and an end cap.
body: I designed this stand to fit the Genesis DPV.  The stand will fit a Blacktip as well.  I also use this to transport the scooter to the dives sites.  The tube and cap parts are glued into the stands.  The design also accepts a 2x4 through the stands

name: Genesis DPV Compass Mount
description: A compact compass mount for the Genesis DPV that attaches using a tank strap or bungee.
body: I designed this simple compass mount for my Genesis DPV. It attaches using a tank strap or bungee and allows magnetic correction for the installed compass. I tested it with the DPV and observed no magnetic interference from the scooter. The STL file is available to download from the Designs listing. Confirm compass accuracy and attachment security with your own equipment before use.

name: TriCell oxygen analyzer
description: A three-cell oxygen analyzer project, kind of a silly project but I have the cells to play with.  Currently working on the bench on a breadboard.  Next task is to create a housing that organizes the cells and allows for proper gas flow over the cells.
body: Work in progress on a three-sensor oxygen analyzer. This is a development prototype, not a validated diving instrument. I will document the electronics, enclosure iterations, and testing in the blog.
